meta.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Ibrahim Salama
meta.description: Find clear answers to the most common questions about our gym services, plans, and policies.

question1.title: Can I migrate my data from my current system?
question1.answer: Absolutely. We’ll handle the entire migration process for you — completely free of charge.

question2.title: What kind of support do you offer?
question2.answer: Our team is available 24/7 via WhatsApp, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and phone. And if needed, we’re even ready to travel to your location.

question3.title: How quickly can my account be set up?
question3.answer: It usually takes 1 week for standard subscriptions.

question4.title: Will I receive future updates?
question4.answer: Yes — you’ll always have access to the latest features and updates.

question5.title: Is there a user limit?
question5.answer: Not at all. You can add unlimited users.

question6.title: How many clients can use the apps?
question6.answer: Unlimited. There are no restrictions on the number of clients.

question7.title: Do you have Arabic-speaking support staff?
question7.answer: Yes, we do. Our team includes fluent Arabic speakers.

question8.title: What if we need a custom feature?
question8.answer: We will present your request to the relevant team, and if it’s deemed valuable and aligned with our roadmap, it will be scheduled as part of our annual updates

question9.title: Do you provide training for staff?
question9.answer: Of course. We offer training sessions as often as needed to ensure you and your team are fully confident using the system.

q1.question: Do I need a membership to book a class?
q1.answer: No — many gyms offer drop-in classes you can book without a membership. Open Bookings, find the gym, and pick a class on its calendar.

q2.question: Can I belong to more than one gym?
q2.answer: Yes. Join as many gyms as you like and switch between them using the gym selector at the top.

q3.question: How do I pause or cancel my membership?
q3.answer: Open the Memberships tab to manage your plan. If your gym allows self-service, you can pause or cancel there; otherwise contact your gym.

q4.question: How are payments handled?
q4.answer: Payments go directly to your gym through their own secure Stripe account. Manage your saved cards under Payment methods.

q5.question: How do I get into the gym?
q5.answer: Show the QR pass from your overview at the front desk or scanner.
